SELECT SEQ_REVIEW_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO REVIEWS ( REVIEW_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, PLACE_ID, PLACE_TYPE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{accountId}, #{placeId}, #{placeType}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEWS SET CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, r.PLACE_ID, r.PLACE_TYPE, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEWS r INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON r.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE r.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, r.PLACE_ID, r.PLACE_TYPE, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEWS r INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON r.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE r.PLACE_ID = #{placeId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, r.PLACE_ID, r.PLACE_TYPE, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN r.PLACE_TYPE = 'FOOD' THEN COALESCE( (SELECT TITLE FROM RESTAURANTS_DETAIL WHERE ID = r.PLACE_ID), r.PLACE_ID ) WHEN r.PLACE_TYPE = 'STAY' THEN COALESCE( (SELECT TITLE FROM STAY_DETAIL WHERE CONTENT_ID = r.PLACE_ID), r.PLACE_ID ) WHEN r.PLACE_TYPE = 'TOUR' THEN COALESCE( (SELECT TITLE FROM TOUR_SPOTS WHERE SPOT_ID = TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.PLACE_ID, '[^0-9]', ''))), r.PLACE_ID ) ELSE r.PLACE_ID END AS PLACE_NAME FROM REVIEWS r INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON r.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE r.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC
